updatedBy: The release commit that cuts the version, before the tag is pushed. The publish workflow refuses to publish while this file disagrees with the version and dist-tag it is about to move (`npm run check:release-pin`), so a release cannot advance a dist-tag past this pin. Every document that quotes a dist-tag is checked against this file by `npm run check:facts`, which also verifies the file against the registry whenever npm is reachable.
